name: Senpai ga Watashi no Mousou ni Doujin Suru?! ~Body Touch ni Goyoujin~
original_name: 先輩が私の妄想にドージンする？！～ボディータッチにご用心～
source:
Two-dimensional erotic posters and tapestries fill the walls of my room.
On the shelves are erotic doujinshi, erotic manga, and erotic games.

In this completely male domain, Komomo-san, a junior girl in the manga research club, came over.

Komomo-san offers me an erotic Doujin of her own creation.
She said she wanted to hear what my senior who likes erotic manga thought of it!

And how can I make this manga more erotic?
Komomo-san asked me seriously.

Then I must answer seriously too!

The moment I faced Komomo-san's erotic doujinshi with all my might, my consciousness entered the world of doujinshi!
I was in-dojinshi, I was dojin!

So, I struggled to eroticize the character that Ms. Komomo had in mind.

[Translated from http://www.silkysconnect.jp/doozinsuru/bodytouch.html]
